title: Nasty Juice Wicked Haze 50/50 10ml E-Liquid
description: Nasty Juice’s Wicked Haze is an e-liquid as sweet and refreshing as it is moreish. A cool, tangy summer soda in vape form: lush, tart blackcurrants are dominant on the inhale softening beneath a zesty lemonade with just a hint of mint on the exhale for maximum refreshment. This e-liquid from Nasty Juice offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing immaculate flavour and rich, satisfying clouds. This e-liquid is versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits .
